description: Fixed same-history check of C-auto-continuation using three bootstrapped RawNodes. Commit implicit removal of voter 3, interpose TransferLeader(2) after leader ApplyConfChange and before Advance, drop emitted TimeoutNow only through tick 10, then deliver all traffic. Compare projected full protocol/caller state at ticks 20 and 30 with a ten-tick repeatable schedule. Stop at tick 30 and separately issue a diagnostic new proposal. The control omits transfer and is excluded by input policy.

harness.description: Serialized public RawNode APIs with read-only internal observation. Fresh bootstrap generates membership history; all peer messages arise from actual Ready output and are protobuf-cloned into a FIFO transport. Persist MemoryStorage, apply entries/configurations and Advance in order. No spawned goroutines or deferred callbacks; RawNode needs no shutdown method. Full JSON state retained at both suffix cuts, without hashes.
semantic_changes: Substitute in-memory synchronous storage for durable media in no-crash scope.
Replace external transport with a FIFO queue; transiently drop transfer-trigger network messages by predetermined type/time policy.

Read internal state with reflection, omitting only logger/traceLogger, storage mutex and diagnostic call counters; retain all semantic fields including private inflight state and timers. No target state is written by observation.
Compare handler function identities and captured receiver state; no alternate algorithm or callback implementation.
Status.Config.AutoLeave is retained only diagnostically; principal selector reads live raft.trk.Config.AutoLeave.

legality.derivation: Bootstrap supplies real initial entries, followed by actual election, committed proposal and applied configuration. RawNode calls are serialized; interposing transfer while Ready awaits Advance is permitted by Node.run processing other messages in that state. Persistence and application finish before Advance and publication. Network may lose messages; no local storage response is dropped. Subsequent reliable delivery and ticks provide both joint majorities. The historical prefix is generated, not injected or inferred from a guard.
legality.applicability: Ordinary storage mode, no crashes, all three peers available, fixed loss window, accepted configuration application.

grounding.derivation: Under C-auto-continuation, a recurrent behavior-determining state with live automatic joint transition still pending, after transfer cleared and with only fully delivered ordinary heartbeat traffic, is a sufficient witness of absent automatic continuation. Compare whole recursively projected RawNode/raft/log/tracker/MemoryStorage state plus caller queues and applied cursors at the same periodic phase, not just business fields. Existing tick and empty-context heartbeat handlers do not draw randomness on this suffix: all nodes retain role/term and follower election clocks are reset by heartbeat each round. Randomized timeout values themselves are included. Exact unchanged state plus the same repeated input schedule supports repeating this suffix; the ten-tick interval is a period, not a promised deadline.
grounding.applicability: Fixed failed-transfer policy selected independently before execution. All nodes receive a tick each round; FIFO dispatch and synchronous Ready completion drain every round after finite loss.
alternatives: If state equality or quiet-suffix restrictions fail, this predicate supplies no recurrent-stall witness; bounded holds does not prove eventual transition.
No-transfer control and later proposal are diagnostics; no obligation is inferred from their result.

observable_properties.description: An admitted automatic transition must not remain pending in an exactly recurrent protocol/caller state under the continuing fully delivered heartbeat/tick schedule after transfer expiry. The result is the sufficient recurrent-stall discriminator; its false value alone does not establish general liveness.

uncertainties: Attribution depends on correspondence review of the state projection and suffix closure; process PASS cannot establish this.
Logger objects, storage diagnostic counters/mutex and allocation capacity are outside protocol state; no crash, concurrency or entry mutation occurs.
Global RNG state is not projected; source and observed heartbeat-only stable-role suffix must establish it is not consulted.
Only this concrete recurrent suffix is compared; failure to witness recurrence cannot prove the universal continuation obligation.
